## Progress

The general separably closed translated-drop producer is complete:

- [`Pic0RankOneTranslatedCoverGeneral.lean`](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0RankOneTranslatedCoverGeneral.lean:57) supplies per-`K`/per-`lambda` `SepClosedTranslatedDropData`, including `baseSubtraction`, finite support, and residue-one compatibility.
- [`Pic0RankOneTranslatedCoverEffective.lean`](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0RankOneTranslatedCoverEffective.lean:86) provides the effective residual consumer.
- [`Pic0RankOneTranslatedCoverLayer.lean`](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0RankOneTranslatedCoverLayer.lean:101) places the translated class directly in `picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ)`, with `IsSplitWitness` and the general producer theorem.

The implementation uses the existing degree/genus layer and does not introduce a fieldwise substitute or unrelated existential carrier. Protections I-1924, I-1925, and I-1926 were respected; no protected Phase-3/4/Pic0CriticalPath files or `VanishingFieldDescent` were edited.

Durable implementation/index commits include `9e01ad4fa4`, `a7826c4af3`, and closeout commits `b32aa3e21b` and `5bd7b71249`.

## Checks

- Narrow `lake env lean` checks for `Pic0SepClosedCover`, General, Effective, and Layer all exited 0.
- Fresh translated-layer module build exited 0.
- `lean_verify` audits for the layer, producer, and immediate consumers report only `propext`, `Classical.choice`, and `Quot.sound`.
- Layer source scan found no `sorry` or `axiom`; only expected local-instance warnings at lines 37-38.
- All five owned graph-node blobs are present in `HEAD`; owned source and graph paths are clean.

A full project build was intentionally not run because the request called for narrow checks and the recovery/openness runs were active.

## Issues

The exact `PicRankOneOpen/FibrePresented` endpoint remains blocked. Recovery now has a kernel-checked native piece-section/presheaf/sheaf-isomorphism and `nativeModule_isLineBundle` handoff, but arbitrary-cartesian pushforward base change, H0/H1/rank certificates, and the tied family producer are still missing.

The task and roadmap remain marked `blocked`. Residual pre-existing graph debt is recorded in I-1922; pre-existing style warnings are recorded in I-1942. Shared Horizon inbox item/history files remain volatile and may be uncommitted by concurrent lanes; no authored source or graph changes remain uncommitted.

## Why I stopped

The remaining work crosses the recovery-owned Phase-4/native-presentation boundary. Completing it here would require protected-file changes or an unjustified endpoint theorem, so the lane stops at the verified translated-cover brick without claiming `PicRankOneOpen` membership.

## Next

The recovery owner should consume the native handoff in the protected Phase-4 path, construct the arbitrary-affine presentation family, and then import this exact `rankOneLayer`/`IsSplitWitness` result into the final `PicRankOneOpen/FibrePresented` consumer.
